description: This is a Dart source file defining the AuthProvider class, which manages authentication state, token persistence, and exposes operations such as login, logout, and registration for a Flutter application.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: Maintains authentication state, token persistence, and provides login/logout/register operations, extending ChangeNotifier to notify listeners of state changes.

methods.name: loadFromStorage
methods.description: Loads authentication token from shared preferences, updates auth service with token, and fetches user info if token exists.

methods.name: _saveToken
methods.description: Saves the authentication token to shared preferences.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Performs user registration; manages loading state.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login, updates token and user info, manages loading state.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears authentication token and user info, removes token from shared preferences.

methods.name: updatePassword
methods.description: Updates the user's password through auth service, manages loading state.
